svg.aria-label: A rocket base at night: every project is a rocket at its true stage. A hologram at Idea; Odanda Gör, BİİİP and ZIP RUSH are bare frames at Prototype; VeriPilot fires its engine at Working without a nose; Pass and Veri Temizleyici stand finished in the Built hangar; KESEN holds at T-10 on the Review pad; Live is an empty orbit.
svg.text: Every project is a rocket. The more complete it looks, the closer it is.
Nothing is in orbit yet — KESEN is on the pad.
